summary: Re-derived at the new line numbers rather than carried forward from pass 2, because the branch absorbed a 130-commit master merge in between and a merge is exactly the event that can quietly undo a verified finding. The scan is `if (upload && !tcg_enabled())` at :3515, so no call with upload == false reaches bitmap_test_and_clear_atomic at :3530. The gate is `bool gate_open = upload && (!current_binding || pg_surface->buffer_dirty || mem_dirty)` at :3603; `if (gate_open) {` opens at :3610 and closes at :3934; both consumers -- `surface->upload_pending |= mem_dirty` at :3812 and `surface->upload_pending = shelf_stale || mem_dirty` at :3883 -- are inside it. A producer that only runs when upload is true cannot starve a consumer that only runs when upload is true.
scenario: Pass 1's scenario -- a binding-absent download eats the guest's CPU-write bits, the next upload opens the gate on !current_binding, computes mem_dirty == false because this call already consumed the evidence, leaves upload_pending false and takes the stale host image -- still cannot occur. A download performs no scan at all.
evidence: Re-checked the one way the widening could be wrong rather than merely redundant, because 130 commits of master arrived since pass 2 checked it: if a download set DIRTY_MEMORY_NV2A, a retained bit would no longer mean a real CPU write and the following upload would push guest RAM over a possibly-newer host image. Re-grepped the whole writer set in hw/: vk/blit.c:757, vk/blit.c:924, gl/blit.c:686 -- guest-visible blit writes, which is what the bit is for -- plus the guest's own stores via memory_region_set_log(d->vram, true, DIRTY_MEMORY_NV2A) at nv2a.c:1283. Unchanged, no new writer anywhere. Also established that master brought no competing change to this code: `git log origin/master --not HEAD -- hw/xbox/nv2a/pgraph/vk/` is EMPTY, so the merge could not have silently reshaped the gate, the tail or the probes -- a mergeable merge is also a semantically quiet one here, stated explicitly rather than inferred from the absence of a conflict marker. summary: Not fixed, and the deferral is accepted. blit.c:778-786 still justifies pgraph_vk_solid_line()'s direct upload_pending write with a reason this PR makes false -- "their scans test-and-clear it before the guard that consumes it, and with upload == false on a live binding the bit is cleared and discarded" -- when with the scan upload-only, upload == false now clears nothing. vk/blit.c is in [free] and is not this lane's file, so fixing it is a territory claim this lane does not hold.
scenario: Unchanged from pass 2: a lane sent to simplify pgraph_vk_solid_line(), or the lane that closes #91 and reads every DIRTY_MEMORY_NV2A site, checks the comment against vk/surface.c, finds the scan upload-only and GL with no surface term at all, concludes the hazard is gone, and replaces the direct upload_pending write with a memory_region_set_client_dirty(..., DIRTY_MEMORY_NV2A). On the device that route is dead under !tcg_enabled(), so the solid line's write reaches no surface and the VkImage keeps stale content.
remediation: The board owes this a one-line territory answer: either grant vk/blit.c to this lane or route it to whoever takes that file next. The conclusion -- keep the direct write -- is still right and the reason is now stronger, so it is a two-sentence rewrite, not a change of decision. It is a LOW and must not hold this PR, and it must not be dropped either: the comment's conclusion is right while its stated reason is now wrong, which is the configuration a future simplification lane deletes.
evidence: The hazard is not left silent -- it is written down at docs/lanes/clrsurf91/NOTES.md:433-496, and the PR body asks the board directly whether this lane may have the file. That is the documented handling for a defect outside a lane's grant.

summary: The PR carries `regressed`: [job.arms] judged the registered prediction FAIL at 16:18Z with arm B byte-identical to arm A on all 11 captures. jobs/fold.sh:503-513 reads that label and declines to fold. fold-ready is still the correct label to set -- fold.sh's own comment says "Your fold-ready label is kept and your head is not marked failed ... the fold re-tries every tick and folds the moment the label clears" -- so setting it is not a claim that this will fold.
scenario: Not a scenario. The two ways forward are the owner's regression-accepted:<issue> label or a fix that makes the arms job re-judge (it computes the label from the verdicts and clears it itself; it must not be removed by hand). That is an owner decision about whether to take a correctness-only change that moves no pixels, and an audit does not rule on it.
evidence: Recorded here rather than left to the fold comment because pass 2 recorded it and the next reader needs it in the same place as the verdict.
